title: Text Classification
seoDescription: Train a Laplace-smoothed Multinomial Naive Bayes text classifier and predict labels for test documents.
description:
Train a Laplace-smoothed Multinomial Naive Bayes text classifier and predict discrete category labels for unseen documents.

Multinomial Naive Bayes models document generation as drawing words with replacement from class multinomial urns.

### Mathematical Formulation
$$
\hat{y} = \arg\max_c \left[ \log P(c) + \sum_{w \in d} \log \frac{N_{cw} + 1}{N_c + |V|} \right]
$$

### Step-by-Step Implementation
1. Build unique vocabulary index and compute class prior probabilities
2. Calculate Laplace-smoothed word token likelihoods per class
3. Predict test document categories via maximum a posteriori log-probability

### Returns
List of predicted class labels for test documents.
